A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Discrete Guidance work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite reformatting and appendix reorganization.

before.justification: v3 reports original evaluations on molecular generation, enhancer DNA generation and protein inverse folding in Section 6, plus CIFAR-10 experiments in Appendix F.1.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including the additional evaluations and analyses in Appendix F.

M1.justification: Appendix F.3.2 changes the reported enhancer classifier architecture from summing final representations to mean pooling. The core predictor guidance, predictor-free guidance, TAG and fixed-component procedures remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the classifier was retrained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CIFAR-10, QMugs-derived molecular, enhancer DNA and protein datasets and tasks. The evaluated cell types, proteins and molecular target scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments: CTDD, DiGress, Dirichlet FM variants and ProteinMPNN remain. Removing the DirFM-CG description from Figure 12's caption corrects the caption; that comparator is absent from the plotted comparison in both versions.

E3.justification: The sum-to-mean pooling revision in Appendix F.3.2 changes a previously stated experimental model configuration. Other reported splits, metrics, training budgets, sampling procedures and guidance sweeps are retained. This documentation revision does not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The same exact-versus-TAG comparisons, guidance sweeps, molecular validity and diversity analyses, enhancer supplementary metrics and predictor validation remain. No new ablation, robustness test or case study is reported.

E5.justification: v4 removes Appendix F.4.6's statement linking bold table values to one-sided t-tests against the best result. The molecular standard errors and Mann-Whitney tests, enhancer bootstrap reporting and Figure 4 significance explanation remain unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical results in Tables 2–11, empirical plots in Figures 2–14 and generated examples are retained. Rankings and qualitative findings also remain unchanged. Molecular validity uncertainties are reformatted into plus-minus notation without changing their values.

T1.justification: Appendix B qualifies v3's unqualified exact Gillespie simulation statement by specifying time-homogeneous CTMCs and identifying an extension for time-dependent rates. The central guidance proofs and fixed-component derivation remain mathematically equivalent after reordering and notation changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and discussion retain the same claims: a tractable CTMC guidance framework, an efficient Taylor approximation and demonstrations across multiple domains. No new central contribution or stronger empirical claim is introduced.

C2.justification: Appendix F.2.6 replaces the asserted superiority of flow models over diffusion with a more cautious potential benefit from correcting tokens later during sampling. Appendix E.2 adds substantive discussion of predictor approximation and obstacles to extending guidance without noisy-predictor training to discrete inputs.

D1.justification: v4 adds Algorithms 1–3 summarizing training and guided sampling, expands implementation explanations and supplies a source-code link in a new reproducibility statement. Listing 4 also fixes the variable-definition mismatch involving inverse_guide_temp. These improve documentation of largely existing procedures.

R1.justification: v4 adds Anderson (2007) on CTMC simulation and Chung et al., Song et al. and Wu et al. on alternative conditional sampling approaches. It removes several citations, including Rhodes and Gutmann, de Haas et al. and Kao et al. The central positioning against DiGress and Dirichlet FM is retained.

P1.justification: v4 makes localized prose corrections and explanatory expansions, reorganizes Appendix C, separates noisy-predictor training into its own subsection and adds ethics and reproducibility statements. The main narrative and section sequence remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: The paper undergoes document-wide reformatting into the ICLR template, changing title and heading typography, headers, spacing and placement of content. Three algorithm displays are added, appendix image grids are regrouped, and Figure 1's predictor panel is recolored to share the other panels' brightness convention. Empirical plot content and table structures are preserved.

improvement.justification: v4 improves usability through explicit algorithm summaries, a source-code link and the Listing 4 variable fix, while making several explanations and qualifications more precise. The empirical evidence and principal theory remain unchanged. The gains are limited, and the newly added cross-entropy Equation 5 omits the minus sign present in Algorithm 1, introducing a small internal inconsistency.
